whenToUse: There are so many features and screens that menus alone make them hard to find.
Experienced keyboard users need a shortcut.
You let people find actions across areas such as documents, settings, and team management in one place.
whenNotToUse: There are only a few features, which can be shown on screen.
Main actions would be hidden only in the palette, where newcomers won't find them.
Mobile is the main way people use it.

alternatives.name: Dropdown Menu
alternatives.reason: A few actions on one object.

accessibility: Make the input role="combobox" and the list role="listbox" with groups (role="group"), announcing the active item with aria-activedescendant.
Focus stays in the input while ↑↓ move and Enter runs; Esc or a click on the backdrop closes it.
Enter during Korean input composition only confirms the character and doesn't run a command.
Add a button on screen that opens it too, so people who don't know the shortcut can open it.
